title: Stretch: The Google Chrome Story
coreMove: Set a bold reach target that forces stronger execution without becoming hype.
sourcePressure: Google Chrome is the company case for stretch, with narrow support for bold targets and grounded accountability but no internal launch detail.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Do not invent Chrome launch metrics, product tactics, or management scenes.

sourceAnchors.name: Google Chrome
sourceAnchors.detail: The source stabilizes Google Chrome as the company case for stretch, while blocking invented internal scenes, launch detail, and product metrics.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Google Chrome should show stretch as a disciplined reach past a safe ceiling, not as a louder promise about growth.

hook: A team discovers OKRs in a conference room and suddenly gets aligned
A dashboard glows on a Monday morning and reveals the truth
A leader writes a goal on a whiteboard and everyone understands
opening with Stretch: The Google Chrome Story as a definition rather than a pressure
counterintuition: Measurement is not bureaucracy, it is clarity
Goals are not dreams, they are systems
Accountability is not punishment, it is ownership
Google Chrome is not a mindset, it is a system
tryThisNow: Set a timer and write three goals
Ask yourself what matters most right now
write one OKR without checking whether it changes behavior
